prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1232; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: The vehicle arrived with a rear quarter impact on the driver side, consistent with the account of being struck while turning left. Most of the damage lines up with that direction of force, including the bumper cover, rear panel, and tail lamp bracket. A few older scratches along the lower door edge may predate this loss and have been noted separately. The repair plan replaces the damaged bumper cover and rear panel section, with refinishing and a light tail lamp reinstall. The labor hours requested fit the scope of the damage, and the parts and charges on the bill show no repeated entries.
